-- Angel Street (2013) - thriller/mystery
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Angel Street' AND t.name IN ('Drama', '2013', 'Mystery', 'Thriller', 'Victorian Era', 'Summer Stock')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- All My Sons (2010) - Arthur Miller drama
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'All My Sons' AND t.name IN ('Drama', '2010', 'Arthur Miller', 'Historical', 'Family Drama', 'College Theatre')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
